title: Add database migration system with Cloud Run Job
description:
Replace the current schema-in-container approach with a proper migration system.

## Why
- Current approach only handles initial schema creation (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS)
- Cannot handle schema changes like adding columns, indexes, or constraints
- As the app evolves, we need version-controlled, incremental migrations

## Scope
1. Choose and integrate a migration tool (e.g., node-pg-migrate, knex)
2. Convert existing schema.sql to initial migration
3. Create Cloud Run Job for running migrations
4. Update CI/CD to run migration job before deploying services
5. Document migration workflow for developers

## References
- Cloud Run Jobs docs: https://cloud.google.com/run/docs/create-jobs
